standard.coverage: Covered employers under this state's own act, which adopts or matches the federal rate.
standard.note: Wisconsin's own rate is $7.25 (Wis. Admin. Code DWD 272.03).

tipped.note: Wisconsin's own cash wage for tipped employees is $2.33.

youthAndTraining.label: Opportunity wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees under 20, first 90 CONSECUTIVE days of employment -- Wis. Stat. 104.035(2). Higher than the federal $4.25 youth wage, so it is the binding figure in Wisconsin.

indexation.note: Not indexed; moves only if the legislature (or Congress) moves it.

sources.title: Wisconsin Legislature -- Wis. Stat. 104.035 (minimum wage; opportunity employees)
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session for the $5.90 opportunity wage; the statute section itself was surfaced but not rendered in full.
